evidence.author: Khamisuabubakar
evidence.used: bare red earth ground, grass-thatched shades at left and right edges, livestock (goats and sheep) in the open, dark pyramid-roofed buildings at the back, baobab-like and broadleaf trees, low eye-level viewpoint

review.gaps: pavilions too big and cover the crowd; people are simple capsule figures, goats are tiny generic cows; ground is saturated red not dusty tan; no litter; pyramids too tall and baobab approximated by acacia
